name: Linux Kernel Security
description: The Linux kernel has one of the most rigorous peer review processes in open source. All patches must be reviewed by at least one maintainer through a hierarchical system flowing to Linus Torvalds.

peerReview.processDescription: All patches reviewed by at least one maintainer. Hierarchical maintainer system flowing to Linus Torvalds. Kernel CVE Program coordinates with MITRE/CNAs. Stable kernel team reviews and backports security fixes.

attribution.attributionNotes: Linux kernel contributors gain significant professional recognition. CVE credits for kernel vulnerabilities are highly respected.

povsAlignment.description: Code repository contribution through rigorous maintainer-based peer review system.
